How do I make a quick buck?
answer: I make a quick buck by placing my right foot close to my left heel, bending my right knee, and at the same time straightening my left knee, so that my body is nearly erect, my right hand being at the small of my back. I then throw my weight partly on my right leg, and spring forward. (Fig. 25.)

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: In making a quick buck, I bend the right knee, slightly, and, at the same time, throw the left leg over the right, so that the feet are brought parallel, and close together. (See Fig. 3.)

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: To make a quick buck, pass the right foot quickly in front of the left, and immediately bring the left foot up in line with the right. [See diagram, p. 34.]

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: I make a quick buck by bending forward, at the same time raising my legs, so that my toes are pointed to the ground, and my back is arched. This brings me into the position of a hare or a rabbit sitting on its haunches. (Fig. 1.)

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: To make a quick buck, raise the heels, keeping them together, and throw the body upwards and backwards, clear of the ground.

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: I make a quick buck by bringing my hands from the small of the back to the front of the thighs, and at the same time bending the body quickly forward.

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: To make a quick buck, raise the rifle smartly from the hollow of the shoulder, bringing the butt to a horizontal position, and at the same time raising the hand as high as the elbow, so that the barrel may point to the rear of the mark; then lower the rifle gradually till the mark is covered, and fire, keeping the rifle perfectly steady. The rifle should be held rather low, so as to allow for the natural forward motion of the body in bringing it to the mark. Quickness and steadiness are the great requisites in this mode of shooting.

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: To make a quick buck, lean forward, and, without checking speed, throw the weight of the body on to the ball of the left foot, at the same time bringing the right foot well up, and finishing the movement with a slight spring from the ball of the left foot. In doing this, great care must be taken not to turn the toes of either foot out, but to keep them pointed straight to the front. Buck quickly, and do not dwell on the movement. 5.

question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: I make a quick buck by throwing my weight forward, bringing my right leg smartly up, and at the same time raising my left leg, so that the ball of my foot may clear the ground. question: How do I make a quick buck?
answer: By drawing back the left leg, bending the knee, and at the same time raising the right leg from the ground, and throwing it forward. By this means the impetus acquired by the right leg in falling forward propels the body in a backward direction. 5
